_meta.title: Immigration detention centres: every ICE facility in the US, and those Wikidata records elsewhere
_meta.what: United States: every facility the Deportation Data Project lists as having held people for US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), with the latest type, who it holds and stay length it records (CC0). Its authors say 133 facility locations are uncertain. Elsewhere: every item Wikidata files as an immigration detention center (or a subclass) outside the US (CC0). Detention of people for their immigration status is one of the ways states treat non-citizens differently; this layer shows where it happens and who runs it.
